jobs.description:
We're producing a series of content-only UGC videos for paid Meta ads (Instagram/Facebook). This is a content-only deal — no posting required on your own page, no whitelisting/account access needed. You film, we get full usage rights, one flat fee per video.

We're hiring for 8 different script/story angles for a wellness supplement brand. You don't need to fit all of them — apply with your samples and, in your proposal, tell us which angle(s) below feel like a natural fit for your on-camera style. We'll assign the matching script privately once hired.

Content angles we're casting for:

"Energy" — daily exhaustion, parent-life pace, honest and emotional tone

"Focus" — brain fog, desk/work-life angle

"Immunity" — getting sick often, grounded and relatable tone

"Gut" — bloating, candid and open tone

"Vitality" — enthusiastic, product-led, "let me show you why I love this"

"The Drawer Dump" — product demo style (you'll need ~8 empty/spare supplement bottles as props for one shot)

"Nature Build It First" — thoughtful, narrative, slightly educational tone

"If I Could Only Keep One" — decisive, confident, a little playful tone

Requirements:

Based in the US, comfortable on camera, natural/warm delivery (not "reading an ad")

Own smartphone capable of shooting vertical 1080×1920

Quiet home setting available (kitchen/living room)

Willing to follow a script's meaning/order exactly (your own wording is fine, structure isn't)

Past UGC or talking-to-camera samples required to apply

CREATOR STANDARDS – read before every shoot Applies to every script we send you.

1. How to shoot

Film everything in 1080×1920 (9:16), vertical. That's your master – always shoot the widest safe framing so it can be recropped later. Keep your face and the product away from the extreme edges.

Look natural and friendly. Be alive, use real intonation, react, smile, pause. Do not read the script like a robot – relax and have fun with it. That energy is the single biggest thing that makes a video work.

2. The script

You can rephrase any line however feels natural and clear to you – your words, your rhythm.

Two rules: keep the meaning of every line, and keep the order of the lines. Don't drop a line, don't merge two, don't reorder.

3. Compliance – hard rules

No medical claims. Ever.

Never say the product treats, cures, heals, fixes, prevents, or reverses anything, and never name a condition or illness

Never say "FDA-approved," "clinically approved," or "doctor recommended"

Never compare it to a medication or name a drug

Never say "guaranteed," "100%," "miracle," or "works for everyone"

Never give a timeframe for results ("in 3 days," "after a week," "right away")

Use support words only: supports, helps, promotes, helps maintain

If you're unsure whether a change crosses a line, ask before you film.

4. What you deliver

A. Main video – edited, in TWO sizes

1080×1920 (9:16)

1080×1350 (4:5)

Both versions: B-roll cut in per the brief, background music, and dynamic subtitles.

B. Raw footage – unedited Every shot and every line from the script. No cuts, no music, no filters, no subtitles.

C. Testimonial – 20–30 seconds Just you, one continuous shot, no B-roll, in your own words: what the product is and how it helped you. Only 1080×1920 (9:16), with dynamic subtitles. Show the product clearly on camera. Same compliance rules apply.

5. Subtitles

Word by word – one word appears at a time, matching exactly what you say.

Keep them inside the safe zone so the Instagram interface never covers them:

9:16 → nothing important in the top ~15% or bottom ~20% of the frame

4:5 → keep subtitles roughly centered vertically

6. Music

Neutral instrumental background only, no lyrics. Volume at 40% maximum – your voice always stays clearly on top.

Quick checklist before you send:

☐ 9:16 edited

☐ 4:5 edited

☐ raw footage, all shots and lines

☐ testimonial 20–30s, 9:16

☐ word-by-word subs on all edited files

☐ subs clear of the IG interface

☐ music instrumental, ≤40%

☐ no compliance red lines

☐ product visible and in focus

Usage rights: Full, perpetual, worldwide buyout for paid media use (Meta Ads). No organic posting on your own channel, no whitelisting.

Budget: $500 per video (open to discussing).

jobs.title: UGC Creators (Couples Welcome) - Daily Short-Form Videos, Paid Per 1,000 Views
jobs.location: US, UK, CA, AU, Europe · Remote
jobs.description:
About us

Loventure is a mobile app for couples — a shared space where two people plan, remember, and actually do things together instead of letting the relationship run on autopilot. We're growing through short-form video, not ads, and we're looking for creators to build that content engine with us.

What we're looking for

Creators who post consistently on their own Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts accounts and want a long-term paid partnership rather than a one-off gig.

Couples are strongly preferred. The content works best when both partners are on camera — reactions, banter, small everyday moments. That said, plenty of our scenarios work solo (POV scripts, storytimes, talking-head takes, "things I wish we'd done sooner"), so solo creators with the right audience should still apply.

We are not asking for polished ad reads. We want native content that fits your feed, in your voice, with Loventure woven in naturally.

What you'll do

Create and post short-form videos (IG Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts) featuring Loventure

Post to your own accounts — you keep your audience and your creative control

Work from a shared scenario bank we provide (hooks, formats, and prompts that have worked), or pitch your own ideas

Send us view/reach screenshots from your native analytics at the end of each payout period

Grant us usage rights to repost or boost your video on Loventure's channels (this is included in the rate — details below)

Volume

Flexible. Daily is ideal, and there is no cap on how many videos you can produce — the more you post, the more you earn. Tell us in your proposal what cadence you can realistically sustain. We'd rather have 4 solid videos a week for six months than 14 in week one and nothing after.

Payment — CPM (paid per 1,000 views)

Rate: $0.80–$1.00 per 1,000 views, based on your track record, content quality, and whether you're a couple or solo. Rate is fixed at the start of the contract and reviewed after 30 days.

Per-video cap: $150.

Views above roughly 150K–190K on a single video don't add to that video's payout.

😉 Break a monster performer? We'll talk about a bonus separately

Minimum payout: $20 per period. Anything under rolls into the next one.

What counts: views on the video as reported by IG / TikTok / YouTube native analytics. Organic only — no paid promotion of your own posts without our written OK. Obvious view manipulation ends the contract with no payout.

Quick math so nobody's guessing: a video at 50K views pays $40–50. Ten videos a month averaging 50K views is $400–500. A video that hits the $150 cap pays $150. Creators who post daily and land a few strong performers earn considerably more than creators who post twice a week.

We're upfront that this is a performance deal, not a flat fee. If you need guaranteed money per video regardless of results, this isn't the right fit.

Usage rights

Included in the CPM rate: we can repost your video on Loventure's own social accounts and use it in paid ads (whitelisting / Spark Ads) for 12 months from the post date. You keep the original post on your account. We'll never edit the content in a way that misrepresents you.

What we need from you

* Based in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland, or Europe

* Active account with real engagement (we care much more about consistent view counts than follower total. A 4K-follower account that reliably does 30K views beats a 100K account doing 2K.)

* Comfortable on camera and able to shoot, edit, caption, and post independently

* English-language content

* Able to send analytics screenshots on request

Nice to have

* You're an actual couple (dating, engaged, married, long-distance — all good)

* Existing content in relationships, lifestyle, day-in-the-life, or humor

* A sense of what your audience actually stops scrolling for

How to apply

Please include the following. Proposals without these get skipped:

1. Links to your accounts (IG / TikTok / YouTube), not a media kit PDF, actual links.

2. Your typical view range on the last 10 posts, plus your best-performing video of the last 3 months.

3. Solo or couple? If a couple, will both of you be on camera?

4. Realistic posting cadence for Loventure content — videos per week you can sustain for 3+ months.

5. ⭐️ One video concept for Loventure. Two or three sentences is plenty. This is the part we actually read closely.

The hard center of this role: turning real Ren tasks (the calls, the cancellations, the 47-minute holds) into content that travels on its own. One post that reads as an ad costs the deadpan permanently, so the register isn’t a style choice here. It’s the distribution.

T-SHAPED, DEEP IN AT LEAST ONE



Short-form video. Shooting and cutting phone-native video from real raw material: call recordings, screen captures, field footage. Hooks that earn the first second, payoffs that earn the repost.The deadpan register. Writing and performing flat institutional comedy — the situation is deranged, the delivery never is. If you can’t do dry, nothing else transfers.Editorial artifacts. Turning call data into things people screenshot and cite: the Cancellation Index, hold-time leaderboards, “dear [institution]” letters. Content that holds up as journalism, not just posts.Organic distribution. Knowing why something traveled and proving it with numbers instead of vibes. No paid amplification, ever. Paid-campaign instincts corrupt the signal and fail the swap test.

OUR STACK

We shoot phone-first and cut in whatever you’re fastest in, off a growing archive of real call recordings and a locked brand system. There is no ad budget and there won’t be one. Not knowing our exact tools isn’t a dealbreaker; taste and reps are.
